abstract: Maintains non-volatile airborne molecular contamination and particle settlement indices
system_message:
You are Yield contamination control specialist (YLD). You serve as the Yield contamination control specialist (YLD), responsible for tracking non-volatile airborne molecular contamination, particle settlement indices, and substrate surface quality across cleanroom emergency protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Substrate surface roughness（SURF）
information_points.content:
YLD-SURF-DVN：Atomic force microscopy measurements on silicon witness wafers in the lithography bay demonstrate a post-scrub native oxide roughness of 5 nm under the Sub-Atmospheric Cryogenic Scrubbing Protocol.
YLD-SURF-6ED：Atomic force microscopy data from silicon witness wafers in the lithography bay show a post-scrub native oxide roughness of 8 nm for the Vapor-Phase Chemo-Catalytic Neutralization Protocol.
YLD-SURF-T88：According to atomic force microscopy inspection of silicon witness wafers in the lithography bay, the Multi-Stage Reactive Bed Adsorption Protocol results in a post-scrub native oxide roughness of 2 nm.

information_points.title: Maintains non-volatile airborne molecular contamination and particle settlement indices（AER）
information_points.content:
YLD-AER-ALG：Surface acoustic wave monitor logs on wetted bay surfaces 4 hours post-purge indicate that the Sub-Atmospheric Cryogenic Scrubbing Protocol yields an airborne molecular contaminant rebound index of 28%.
YLD-AER-O1U：For the Multi-Stage Reactive Bed Adsorption Protocol, surface acoustic wave monitor logs on wetted bay surfaces 4 hours post-purge establish an airborne molecular contaminant rebound index of 44%.
YLD-AER-9EM：Surface acoustic wave monitor logs evaluating wetted bay surfaces 4 hours post-purge show that the Vapor-Phase Chemo-Catalytic Neutralization Protocol records an airborne molecular contaminant rebound index of 12%.
